name: SunDrop: Sunny Days Fall From The Sky Like Raindrops
source:
Parsley’s world seems normal – school, friends, and small joys – but inside, she is lost and disconnected. When a mysterious girl confronts her, declaring her friends as monsters that must be destroyed, Parsley’s quiet reality collapses.

[From [url=https://ashyrew.itch.io/sundrop]Itch.io[/url]]
